ticket.title: Add the miter, sawhorse, dado and batten wire domains to gaugeblock-contracts

verification_receipt.summary: Merged to common main (a7b49c0): gaugeblock-contracts now carries the miter (Language, SymbolKind, SymbolBinding, LexicalScope, VerificationReport, CompilerDiagnostic), dado/batten (TypedHole, DadoPattern, GrammarFormat, CompiledGrammarConstraint) and sawhorse (ExecutionMode, ModelRole, ReasoningEffort, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse) domains, with cross-domain references resolving inside the crate. Gates: fmt OK, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest --workspace 13/13 (7 new wire-shape tests pinning snake_case spellings, the internal mode tag and DadoPattern::language), chalkline docs check -d common 9/9, workspace 12 targets / 0 drifted. Every file under 250 lines.
